facts.fact: EdTech Hub reports that the Federal Ministry of Education runs AskFME, an AI-powered national education service desk on WhatsApp and its website that answers policy questions and school-census statistics, with 97.3% of chatbot queries resolved without human escalation.

NGA.note: AskFME is a general ministry service desk chatbot, not a tool inside a sector system giving diagnoses or forecasts.
No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted is stated; staff coached to build a chatbot on existing tools.
Only a school census is named; no population census or household survey.
